newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Troy releases strong Cornishman gold shows.
newsitem.headline: Troy releases strong Cornishman gold shows.

text.p: Troy Resources NL on Friday released what it said were significant drilling results from its Cornishman Joint Venture in Western Australia with Sons of Gwalia Ltd, showing intercepts of up to 43 grams per tonne.

Troy, which holds 49 percent of the Cornishman joint venture, released results from 18 intercepts from its drilling programme of 44 holes over 5.1 kilometres, about five kilometres south of Southern Cross in Western Australia.

The intercepts ranged from three metres at 43 grams per tonne to five metres at 3.03 grams per tonne and included intercepts of seven metres at 15.70 grams per tonne and 10 metres at 11.40 grams per tonne.

"Drilling has also substantially extended the strike length of mineralisation from 950 to 1,400 metres, and deeper drilling on several sections has revealed the existence of stacked lodes of mineralisation beneath the Triple-O lode," Troy said.
Sons of Gwalia has a 51 percent share in the joint venture.
Troy's shares were up 34 cents at A$1.35 at 10.45 a.m. (0045 GMT), while Sons of Gwalia's shares were down two cents at A$5.90.
